title: exp.speedtest/1
description: Speedtest result as stored by the collector (12 section 7.1). Built by exp-speedtest from the page's submission (exp.speedtest.submission/1): the server OVERWRITES id, site, client.ip, timestamps it can observe and the score, bounds every number (<= 100 Gb/s, <= 60 s), cross-checks the local leg against its byte counters (flag counters_disagree above 20 %). ANONYMOUS BY CONSTRUCTION: additionalProperties is false everywhere and no field can carry a person's name, email, phone or account; device/network identity lives in exp.evidence/1 kind 'identity'.

zone.description: Resolved after the test from correlation (12 3.1): Mist AP/zone by client IP, else subnet->zone, else a QR hint, else 'unresolved'. Set to 'unresolved' (with flag nat_suspected) when identity resolution fails closed.

zone_source.description: How zone was determined. 'qr' = the ?z= hint stamped by the page (a hint only; flag zone_hint_conflict when correlation disagrees).

ip.description: Server-observed source address of the session (never client-reported). Correlation keys on it (D15). Absent after the privacy scrub.

connection_hint.description: navigator.connection.type when the browser exposes it; a hint only.

client.description: ip is required at ingest (the collector refuses a result without it) but optional in the schema: the privacy scrub (scrub_after_diagnosis) and non-admin views remove it.

consent.description: Version of the consent text shown before the test.

legs.description: Measured legs (12 4.2/7.1). 'internet' is present with status != ok when the leg could not run.

score.description: null when no leg produced a throughput number.

flags.description: Bounded flag set: nat_suspected (identity failed closed), counters_disagree (> 20 % client/server byte mismatch), internet_unavailable / internet_paused / internet_queued (why the internet leg is not ok), dns_fallback (probe DNS used), bytes_capped (per-test byte cap reached), partial (a leg aborted), zone_hint_conflict.

comment.description: Optional 'report a problem' text (SR-23): untrusted, <= 500 chars, rendered with textContent only. Newlines allowed, other control characters not.

local_bytes_down.description: Box counter: bytes served on /st/down for this session.

local_bytes_up.description: Box counter: bytes received on /st/up for this session.

session_ms.description: Server-observed time from session creation to result submission.

status.description: ok = measured. unavailable (internet down / unreachable), paused (admin or WAN auto-pause), queued (no internet slot yet), skipped (client aborted). A non-ok leg carries no throughput numbers.

down_mbps.description: Download throughput, Mb/s: 90th percentile of 250 ms samples after the ramp (12 4.2). <= 100 Gb/s.

idle_ms.description: Median idle RTT (20 pings for the local leg).

loaded_down_ms.description: Median RTT while the download ran (the bufferbloat figure).

loaded_up_ms.description: Median RTT while the upload ran.

rpm.description: Round trips per minute under load (60000 / loaded latency).

cv.description: Coefficient of variation of the throughput samples (stability input).

failures.description: Failed requests during the leg (stability input).

bytes.description: Bytes moved by this leg (browser count). For the local leg the box cross-checks it against its own counters.

server.description: Server label: the box id for the local leg, 'cloudflare:<colo>' (3-letter IATA from /cdn-cgi/trace) for the internet leg.

cold_ms.description: Resource Timing domainLookupEnd - domainLookupStart for a fresh nonce name (resolver recursed to the box's authoritative server).

warm_ms.description: Same for the repeated name (answered from the resolver's cache).

resolver_ip.description: The resolver IP the box's DNS-leg server saw, or null.

source.description: browser = measured by the page through the device's own resolver; probe = fallback to the nearest probe's DNS line ('measured by the hall sensor') when the delegation is missing (flag dns_fallback).

loaded.description: RTT to the hop while the box's own link was loaded (during tests).

samples.description: Number of samples behind the figures.

gateway_ms.description: Box-timed hop (ICMP / TTL-limited trace from the core box).

loaded.description: RTT to the hop while the box's own link was loaded (during tests).

samples.description: Number of samples behind the figures.

edge_ms.description: Box-timed hop (ICMP / TTL-limited trace from the core box).

loaded.description: RTT to the hop while the box's own link was loaded (during tests).

samples.description: Number of samples behind the figures.

edge1_ms.description: Box-timed hop (ICMP / TTL-limited trace from the core box).

edge1_addr.description: Address of the hop one past the edge, or null.

device_icmp_ms.description: Box -> the requesting client only (per test). Never a client-chosen target (SR-22).

path_leg.description: Core -> edge path timed by the box. gateway/edge/edge+1 are SHARED venue-infrastructure context (not per user); device_icmp_ms is per test (CR-m6-spec-resolutions).

os_family.description: Parsed from the User-Agent by the server; the raw UA string is never stored.

ua.description: Coarse client descriptors parsed by the server.

score.description: exp score (12 4.2), always recomputed by the server (exp_common.speedtest.compute_score).

stage.description: quick = from the legs alone; final = after evidence is complete.

ref.description: Pointer into the cited evidence (field path, flow index, log line id)

user_text.description: Plain, blame-free sentence shown to the user.

noc_text.description: Names the evidence (AP, channel, utilization, RSSI) for the NOC.

diagnosis.description: Diagnosis produced by the collector rules (12 5.3). Not part of the wire result; part of GET speedtests/{id} and the user-safe status.
